query_families: golf swing biomechanics motion capture dataset

sources.title: GolfDB: A Video Database for Golf Swing Sequencing
sources.authority: McNally et al. and the official GolfDB repository
blockers: No measured three-dimensional body trajectory is provided.
No measured three-dimensional club trajectory is provided.
Participant-grouped held-out biomechanical evaluation is unavailable.
No downloaded content digest is registered.
sources.notes: Useful for event-label and video-only adverse controls, not articulated-state qualification.

sources.title: GolfPose: From Regular Posture to Golf Swing Posture
sources.authority: Lee et al. official implementation and dataset-access instructions
blockers: Reuse terms must be recorded from the authorization response.
Trial count and participant-group mapping must be verified from delivered files.
No authorized content digest is registered.
sources.notes: Best identified multisubject body-and-club trajectory candidate; it is not yet governed local evidence.

sources.title: KIT Whole-Body Human Motion Database Motion 1319: Golf Drive
sources.authority: Karlsruhe Institute of Technology H2T motion database
blockers: The public page gives citation guidance but no explicit file-reuse license.
Club marker availability and club rigid-body calibration are unverified.
Capture calibration and synchronization metadata are unverified.
One participant cannot support participant-held-out qualification.
No downloaded content digest is registered.
sources.notes: Five public Vicon C3D golf-drive trials can become a pipeline probe only after reuse and content qualification.

sources.title: UpstreamDrift Motion-Pipeline Golden Fixtures
blockers: Software format fixtures are not participant golf observations.
No body-and-club biomechanical measurement contract is present.
No participant grouping or measurement uncertainty exists.
sources.notes: Appropriate for parser and malformed-input controls only.

sources.title: UpstreamDrift 3-D Golf Model Generated Trial Exports
blockers: The files are simulation output rather than human measurements.
No participant, consent, capture-calibration, or measurement-uncertainty authority exists.
Model-generated force and kinematic channels cannot validate the generating model.
sources.notes: May test adapters, but using it for human trajectory qualification would be circular.

inference_boundary: This source registry can identify and qualify trajectory inputs; it cannot establish that the current analytic motion is golf-like, validate passive transfer in humans, satisfy bilateral-wrench issue #8556, or support coaching inference.
